objective: One operator reading of the autonomous funnel. (1) server/services/cash/funnel.ts exports funnelReading(projectId, now) derived from the tiers the view already computes: counts of SIGNAL, CANDIDATE, QUALIFIED, READY_TO_TEST, retired (if cash-autonomy-2 merged) and stale (if cash-autonomy-1 merged); the first blocker per piece (tier.toAdvance[0] with its owner); live discovery rounds; dives and need research in flight against their ceilings; and when the funnel has produced no READY_TO_TEST, one sentence naming the most common first blocker across pieces. (2) It is a section of the existing Cash page (same skeleton for both roles; members get counts and owners, never values) and a FUNNEL block in scripts/cash-report.ts printing each piece id with its tier and first blocker. (3) Read-only, no writes, reuses cashView's loaded rows. (4) Tests: the reading on a fixture portfolio; the section renders in tests/cashSection.test.tsx for both roles.
expectedOutcome: 'Can Brain find things worth testing' is answered by one reading, with the first real blocker named when it cannot.
nonGoals: A second opportunity pipeline, queue, scheduler or polling loop beside the durable Russell tick and operate()
Changing the evidence gate, verification, audit roles or approval envelopes
A full-table read on every tick; every new read is narrow, indexed and bounded
rollbackRequirement: Revert the commits; any migration only adds columns with defaults or a nullable column.
